info.title: Panda control API
info.description: Generated from src/api_contract.ts. Describes the source at this Git revision; older images may lack checkpoint/snapshot support. Query lifecycle.checkpointCapable. A disconnected mutation may still complete; query its operation ID before retrying.

post.description: Commands share this single endpoint and use positional parameters. This is not JSON-RPC 2.0. Most successes return {result}; shutdown returns {id}; an unknown snapshot operation returns {}. See each request variant for its result type.

500.description: Command failed while the service is ready

503.description: Service is parked, in maintenance or faulted

200.description: Lifecycle state without a result envelope

500.description: Command failed while the service is ready

503.description: Service is parked, in maintenance or faulted

200.description: Consume or cancel the stream; verify the declared SHA-256 when saving

x-panda-sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the compressed bytes

500.description: Command failed while the service is ready

503.description: Service is parked, in maintenance or faulted

status.description: Read protocol time, execution head and Beacon finality.

lifecycle.description: Inspect readiness, recovery, checkpoint support and session identity.

resources.description: Read controller CPU and memory usage.

stop.description: Stop native clients at a checkpoint while HTTP remains available.

resume.description: Resume checkpointed clients and replace the session identity.

stepSlot.description: Produce the next slot and complete its duties and tail.

advanceSlots.description: Advance a non-negative integer count of slots honestly.

advanceEpochs.description: Advance a non-negative integer count of 32-slot epochs honestly.

advanceTime.description: Advance by seconds; honest mode is the default.

advanceTo.description: Advance to Unix seconds; the target cannot precede current protocol time.

skipSlots.description: Skip slots as downtime without producing a destination block.

setAutomine.description: Enable or disable mining eligible pending transactions.

importValidator.description: Import one EIP-2335 keystore JSON string with its password.

exitValidator.description: Sign and submit a voluntary exit for a locally managed 48-byte hex public key.

snapshotCreate.description: Save state at a completed slot tail with an empty transaction pool. Retain the operation UUID.

snapshotRestore.description: Restore saved state, replace the session and disable automine. Reset external consumers.

snapshotRemove.description: Delete a saved snapshot without changing the active branch.

snapshotList.description: List saved snapshots belonging to this network owner.

snapshotOperation.description: Query a durable outcome; an unknown UUID returns an empty response object.

ControlCommands.description: Wire commands: positional arguments and the value inside the result envelope.

ProfileName.description: Public wire types shared by the HTTP client and Panda's controller.

ExecutionBlock.description: Latest execution block with transaction hashes and Ethereum hex quantities.

LifecycleState.description: Available while clients are running, stopped or faulted.

Resources.description: Controller process metrics; excludes native client processes.

Checkpoint.description: Native checkpoint receipt; extension fields depend on the checkpoint ABI.

mode.description: Honest executes every duty; fast permits missed duties and inactivity penalties.

sessionId.description: Reset external providers and indexers for this replacement session.

SnapshotOperation.description: Result shape follows the recorded request; a failure may still retain a result.
